description: This file defines the class MockPowerConfigurationCluster, a mock implementation of a Zigbee power configuration cluster used for testing or simulation purposes. It extends MockCluster and implements capability interfaces for battery and temperature measurement, featuring attribute management and alarm event simulation.

classes.name: MockPowerConfigurationCluster
classes.description: A mock class simulating a Zigbee power configuration cluster with attributes for battery and power status, used mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status and sends appropriate attribute report or alarm.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Returns true if the battery is considered low.

methods.name: isACPowerLost
methods.description: Checks if the AC power is lost.

methods.name: setACPowerLost
methods.description: Updates the AC power loss status and triggers an alarm event.

methods.name: isBatteryBad
methods.description: Checks if the battery is bad.

methods.name: setBatteryBad
methods.description: Updates the battery bad status and triggers an alarm event.

methods.name: isBatteryMissing
methods.description: Checks if the battery is missing.

methods.name: setBatteryMissing
methods.description: Updates the missing battery status and triggers an alarm event.

methods.name: isTemperatureHigh
methods.description: Checks if the temperature is high.

methods.name: setTemperatureHigh
methods.description: Updates the high temperature status and triggers an alarm event.

methods.name: setBatteryPercentage
methods.description: Sets the battery percentage remaining and reports the attribute.

methods.name: getBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Retrieves the current battery voltage in decivolts.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Updates the battery voltage and reports the attribute.
